name: automation-pilot-skills
description: Build, operate, and manage cloud operations with SAP Automation Pilot, from your coding agent in plain language.

hostname.title: Automation Pilot hostname
hostname.description: Regional host of your Automation Pilot tenant, e.g. emea.autopilot.cloud.sap. Exposed to the autopi CLI as AUTOPI_HOSTNAME.

username.title: Automation Pilot username
username.description: Technical-user name for HTTP Basic auth against your tenant. Exposed to the autopi CLI as AUTOPI_USERNAME.

password.title: Automation Pilot password
password.description: Password for the technical user. Exposed to the autopi CLI as AUTOPI_PASSWORD; never logged or embedded in URLs.
